provenance.notes: Rate and monthly-result limits come from the publisher's rate-limit contract. Invocation, OAuth, trial-token, and tool side-effect facts were cross-checked against README.md at repository commit 65cbd90da5840391f2b83b141560ef431cb242d3. Pricing is intentionally omitted: the official pricing page combines subscriptions, platform-specific credits, overages, and monthly/yearly billing, which should not be collapsed into one scalar price.

sla.rate_limit: Free: 30 req/min, 2 concurrent, 100,000 results/month; Pro: 120 req/min, 6 concurrent, 1,000,000 results/month; Max: 600 req/min, 20 concurrent, 10,000,000 results/month; Enterprise: custom

conditions: tool is addTrackedItems, removeTrackedItems, or cancelOperation
approval.human_readable: Search tools are read-oriented; tracking and cancellation tools mutate server-side state and may warrant local approval.

operational_constraints.policy_notes: Enterprise limits are custom. Consumers should use retry_after_ms or Retry-After after HTTP 429 and apply their own approval policy. No latency, uptime, quality, or ASM receipt support is claimed.
